description: Read internal draft approval requests and recent external client review feedback across every brand this login holds in one call, newest first and tagged with brandId and brandName. Ideal for agencies triaging approvals across all clients. Changes nothing.

limit.description: Maximum approval requests to return across all brands (1 to 200). Defaults to 50.

status.description: Filter internal approval requests across every brand by status. Defaults to pending.

name: brands_approvals_list
title: List approvals across all brands
